info.title: Acervo platform administration
info.description: Platform A/B/C administration. Atomic institution onboarding and new administrator invitations use owner/type-scoped idempotency. Publication is after commit with explicit recovery and no outbox guarantee. Institution details include current agreement, computed quotas and warnings. Backend completion does not authorize frontend cutover or retirement of compatibility endpoints.

post.description: Immediate immutable revision under institution lock. Existing same-plan amendments preserve source snapshot even after catalog withdrawal; switching selects current available plan with expected revision. All changed role limits require matching reasoned exceptions. Whole-peso CLP strings; no tax/payment calculation. Paid agreements require customer identity. Dates are inclusive Santiago days; future/expired contracts do not change access. Block A does not enforce agreed limits.

get.summary: List institutional user metadata across institutions
get.description: Requires MFA-verified platform Bearer and platform.administrator_access. Excludes soft-deleted users and platform operators. Server-side search, institution, role (none means no memberships) and activity filters. All actual memberships are returned, including multiple or no roles. Invitation data comes from the invitation record; email verification alone is not invitation activation. No user mutation, credentials, token or document data.

post.summary: Prepare verified recovery or contain one account
post.description: MFA platform.access_recovery required. Record external institutional authority, reason and confirmation. New successors do not yet exist as active institutional users; existing successors retain legitimate access. All recovery stages work while suspended without enabling institutional access. ID is globally unique and persisted before post-commit encrypted proof publication. Identical owner/key/body preparation is replayable; conflicts never authorize a fresh key. Address control alone does not establish institutional authority.

post.description: Atomically recheck verified unexpired state, user/institution/agreement revisions and final role occupancy. Replacement cannot increase excess for any role; assigns admin as the sole institutional role of the successor, releases their previous role occupancy, and preserves outgoing roles/responsibilities. Email correction preserves identity, password and activity. Revoke obsolete credentials; never issue a login or reactivate a suspended institution. Completed replay returns the original result without consuming the transition again.

post.summary: Replace all institutional roles with one chosen role
post.description: Requires platform.user_access and current MFA authentication. Institution must be enabled. Institution/user locks, expected access revision, shared quotas and ordinary last usable administrator protection. Role changes preserve identity, password, verification and activity. Eligibility loss requires a fresh impact token and explicit responsibility-removal confirmation. Changes revoke credentials and audit atomically as the actual platform operator. No exceptional containment permission. No automatic retry after an uncertain response: inspect current user revision and audit.
